actions.mechanism: Creation requires rollout permission and format-writing capability; opening depends on stored format and reading capability, not the flag.
actions.implementation: Persist each document's format version. Authorize requests normally, then check the requesting client's declared capabilities before returning content or accepting creation.
actions.check: Exercise flag-on/off against old/new clients and old/new documents. Unsupported opens return an explicit error, never unparseable document bytes.
actions.risk: Declared capabilities can be stale or inaccurate.

actions.action: Preserve existing documents when adopting the new format
actions.mechanism: Explicit forks preserve old-client access without pretending new content has a lossless legacy representation.
actions.implementation: Keep existing document IDs, formats, content, and access intact. Create new-format forks under separate IDs; prohibit in-place migration and automatic link replacement.
actions.check: After forking and editing, an old client still reads the original document through its previous ID without encountering new-format content.
actions.risk: Forks can diverge; users must understand they are separate documents.

actions.mechanism: Format-specific sessions prevent new operations from entering a document shared with old clients.
actions.implementation: Keep legacy sessions on legacy operations. Reject new-format operations there; require an explicit fork. Admit new-format collaborators only after capability checks.
actions.check: Have old and new clients coedit a legacy document; attempt a new-only operation. Verify rejection and continued old-client reads.
actions.risk: Cross-format collaboration requires explicit workflow changes, not transparent synchronization.

actions.action: Make rollback stop creation, not erase documents
actions.mechanism: The rollout flag controls admission; existing-document readers and storage survive flag rollback.
actions.implementation: On rollback, disable new-format creation and edits, retain new-format read service, and preserve stored content. Return explicit read-only errors for writes.
actions.check: Create a new document, roll back, reopen with a capable client, and verify unchanged content; writes fail without modifying storage.
actions.risk: Binary deployment rollback must also retain a compatible reader.

actions.mechanism: Commit-time validation prevents requests authorized before rollback from creating documents afterward.
actions.implementation: Maintain a rollout generation. Atomically validate generation, format permission, and document revision when committing writes; reject stale requests without partial changes.
actions.check: Pause creation before commit, roll back, then resume. Verify rejection with no published document and no changes to existing documents.
actions.risk: Every write path, including background jobs, must enforce the fence.

actions.action: Bind capability caches to the requesting client
actions.mechanism: Session-bound capability declarations prevent one device's newer capabilities from authorizing another device's older binary.
actions.implementation: Key cached capabilities by client session and declaration generation, not account. Bind authorization tokens accordingly; revalidate mismatches and fail closed for new formats.
actions.check: Seed an old session with a new client's cached capabilities. Verify cross-session rejection while legacy reads remain available.
actions.risk: Binding prevents cache confusion, not clients falsely declaring support.

actions.action: Offer an explicit browser reader for new documents
actions.mechanism: A separately deployed compatible viewer can provide access without changing the installed old binary or down-converting stored content.
actions.implementation: Provide an authenticated browser URL for new documents. Render their native format with a versioned reader; keep original bytes and legacy document routes unchanged.
actions.check: Open a shared new document in the browser without upgrading the old binary; verify supported content renders and unauthorized access fails.
actions.risk: Browser rendering needs security isolation and format-specific fidelity testing.
